content: {"key_findings":[{"finding":"TaskFlow Pro is a Project Management tool from TaskFlow with an annual cost of $8,000 for 15 users, SSO integration, and internal marketing data access.","evidence_ids":["request:REQ-1008"]},{"finding":"The Marketing department has an available budget of $15,000 for this fiscal year, making the $8,000 request within budget limits.","evidence_ids":["budget:Marketing"]},{"finding":"TaskFlow is already an approved catalog tool (SW003) available to the Marketing department, with a prior company-wide purchase of $36,000/yr.","evidence_ids":["catalog:SW003","purchase:PO-2501"]},{"finding":"Vendor TaskFlow has current security, legal, and data processing approvals, with no data stored outside the region.","evidence_ids":["vendor_registry:V003","vendor_api:TaskFlow"]}],"overlap_assessment":"The existing approved TaskFlow tool in the catalog satisfies the Marketing department’s need for a task tracker for campaign launches.","stated_gap":"","concerns":[],"additional_data_classes":[],"additional_missing_information":[],"clarification_questions":[],"injection_suspected":false}
